item.tib: rtse drug gnas kyi dkar chags lung bstan yang tig mkha' gsal nyi ma'i zer chen
item.coloph: ces pa'i sum pa gyim shod glang gi yul gyi gnas mchog ri bo rtse drug gi dkar chags (chag) 'di ni gsang gling yab yum gyis bka' gter zung 'brel du babs pa'i rtse drug bla ma g.yung drung tshul khrims rnam rgyal/ tshul khrims dar rgyas/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ nye gnas mtshams pa/ bla grwa yongs kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas rtse drug bla brang gi mchod khang du bris pas dge de'i bstan 'gro'i don chen nus pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
